title: docs(skills): an objectstack-data eval relabels a vendor field with fieldPatches, never by redeclaring it in fields

## 维护者速读

- 改了什么：`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 新增第 7 例：装了 HotCRM 后，作者想让 `crm_account.industry` 字段显示为 "Sector"。标准答案是在配对包 `hotcrm.custom` 里写 `defineObjectExtension({ extend: 'crm_account', fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector' } } })`；必含 `fieldPatches`、`hotcrm.custom`、`extend: 'crm_account'`、`label: 'Sector'`、`defineObjectExtension`，禁含把 `industry` 在 `fields` 里重新声明（`industry: Field.select(`）、`overrides:`、`name: 'crm_account'`。另加一条 changeset。技能正文零改动。
- 为什么改：技能的〈Object Extension Model〉教了"改厂商字段的显示用 `fieldPatches`，不要在 `fields` 里重声明"，但没有任何评测覆盖它；以后为付 token 棘轮而删掉这段，什么都不会红。这一例让这条教学有了守门。
- 风险与回滚：只加一个评测夹具用例与一条 changeset，不改技能文本、不改运行时；评测夹具不计入 token 棘轮（裁决 6513306068 B）。回滚即 revert。
- 先看：`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` 第 7 例（`expected_output` 的每句都对照 `main` 上 `SKILL.md` 〈Object Extension Model〉与 `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` 的 `patchedField` 写成）；`.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md`。
- 两分钟验证：`node scripts/check-skills-token-ratchet.mjs`，预期 `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json is 2150 tokens — eval fixture, measured but not ratcheted`，`skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md is 6087 tokens (ceiling 6123)` 不变；再 `grep -c "label: 'Sector'" skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 得 1，证明每个必含 token 都在技能里教过。
- 需要你做的：本 PR 触 `skills/**`（Tier H），需要受管审批人在 GitHub 上 Approve 一次；之后席位落地。

## What changes

`skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json`: case 7, appended after case 5's `crm_account` extension (the fixture whose topic cluster holds object extensions; `hooks-security-seeds-datasources.json` has no extension case).

- **Prompt:** HotCRM installed; its `crm_account` object's `industry` field should read "Sector" instead of "Industry", without touching HotCRM's source.
- **Expected output:** `defineObjectExtension({ extend: 'crm_account', fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector' } } })` authored in `hotcrm.custom` and registered in `objectExtensions`; a patch carries display keys only (`label`, `description`, `inlineHelpText`, `placeholder`), the field's type, values and rules stay HotCRM's, a tenant-edited key keeps the tenant's text; never redeclare `industry` in `fields` (takes the field over, cuts it off from upgrades, and an unsuffixed field in a `.custom` extension is refused anyway); an option's label rides the same patch keyed by the option's stored `value` only for a field with its own `options`, a `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable, a patch naming a field or option value the target lacks is refused at install and by `os validate`.
- **`must_contain`:** `hotcrm.custom`, `defineObjectExtension`, `extend: 'crm_account'`, `fieldPatches`, `label: 'Sector'`. Each appears as a whole token in `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` on `main` (1, 2, 1, 4, 1 hits; checked with the `IDENT_CHAR` boundary rule of `ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`, whose own population is `skills/objectui` only, so the check for this bundle is by hand).
- **`must_not_contain`:** `industry: Field.select(` (the take-over spelling: HotCRM's field is `Field.select`), `overrides:` (replacing the object whole), `name: 'crm_account'` (redeclaring the object). None names a mechanism a right contrasting answer must spell.

`.changeset/28804-data-eval-field-patches.md`: `'@objectstack/skills': patch`, both declaration lines.

Every sentence of the expected output states what `main` does: `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` 〈Object Extension Model〉 (the whitelist, the take-over rule, the `__c` refusal, the picklist rule), `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts` (`FieldDisplayPatchSchema`, `refuseFieldPatchOfReplacedField`, `fieldPatchesDescription`), `packages/objectql/src/registry.ts` `patchedField` (the picklist-bound `options` skip), `packages/metadata-core/src/extension-field-patch-targets.ts` (the `field` / `option` / `picklist-option` misses the install door and `os validate` refuse by).

**Readings (os-dev rule for `skills/**`):**

| Reading | Before (`origin/main` `4d56914a`) | After |
|:--|:--|:--|
| `skills/objectstack-data/evals/objects-fields-relationships.json` lines | 120 | 140 |
| same file, tokens (`check-skills-token-ratchet`, eval fixture: measured, not ratcheted) | 1749 | 2150 |
| `skills/objectstack-data/SKILL.md` lines / tokens | 465 / 6087 (ceiling 6123) | unchanged |
| Package, all 11 `skills/*/SKILL.md`, lines | 4525 | unchanged |

No ceiling row moves; no skill text is added or deleted.

## Why

#28804: an out-of-scope finding of PR #28795 (card #28730, which added the `fieldPatches` paragraph and is closed completed). With no eval, a later trim made to pay the token ratchet could drop the paragraph and nothing would fail. Evals sit outside the ratchet (ruling record 6513306068 B), so the case costs no skill text.

## Tests

No runtime code changes. The fixture parses as JSON (7 cases, ids 1–7); the case's own `expected_output` contains every `must_contain` token and none of the `must_not_contain` tokens (self-check script in the thread).

## Acceptance notes

- `skills/objectstack-data/evals/` has no runner in this repo; the fixture is parsed as JSON and measured by `check-skills-token-ratchet` (population 1b). The CI eval-token gate (`ui/scripts/check-skill-eval-tokens.mjs`) walks `skills/objectui` only, so the whole-token teaching check for this bundle was done by hand and is recorded above.
- Out of scope, for the seat to judge (class c, noted, not filed): the skill's own example `fieldPatches: { industry: { label: 'Sector', options: { technology: { label: 'Tech' } } } }` (`SKILL.md` line 364, and the same example in `fieldPatchesDescription()` of `packages/spec/src/data/object.zod.ts`) patches an option of `crm_account.industry`, which in HotCRM is `Field.select({ picklist: 'industry' })` (`hotcrm` `src/sales/objects/account.object.ts`). A `picklist`-bound field's options are never patchable, so an author who copies the example against the real HotCRM is refused by `os validate` and the install door with the `picklist-option` miss (`extension-field-patch-targets.ts`). The eval's expected output therefore keeps the `options` form conditional ("only for a field that declares its own `options`"). Reach read off the judge's code path, not measured live.
- Overlap: seat 2's open PRs #30890 (`references/examples-objects.md`) and #30921 (`rules/field-types.md`) touch other files; seat 1's #30805 declares `skills/**` wide. `origin/main` (`4d56914a`) had not moved at push time, so there was nothing to merge; a later move is merged on the next look.
